rule: Every colour that reaches a pixel comes from the worn colour set. Photic holds the baked values; every other set computes its own from its pigments (colour_trace.py repaint). A colour is inert, a UI theme token, fixed (pure white, pure black), traced (an id below), or untraced (listed below: the work left).

inert_why.scene-not-in-build: a colour authored in a scene the player build does not ship (EditorBuildSettings)
inert_why.tmp-colour-twin: TextMeshPro draws m_fontColor; its m_Color is the Graphic field TMP_Text overrides and never reads
inert_why.tmp-face-cache: m_faceColor and m_outlineColor cache the font material's colours; TMP draws the material's
inert_why.tmp-gradient-off: m_fontColorGradient is drawn only with m_enableVertexGradient on (or a gradient preset)
inert_why.kit-selectable: a Kit selectable paints its own graphics; KitSelectableBase.Awake sets its transition to None
inert_why.kit-legacy-field: a colour field a Kit subclass inherits and never reads (it overrides the base hook)
inert_why.selectable-no-tint: a Selectable's ColorBlock tints its target only with the ColorTint transition and a target
inert_why.mask-hidden: a Mask with showMaskGraphic off draws its graphic into the stencil only
inert_why.ps-module-off: a particle module's colours are drawn only while the module is enabled
inert_why.ps-mode-unused: a MinMaxGradient draws only the parts its minMaxState names
inert_why.gradient-key-unused: a gradient draws only its first m_NumColorKeys colour keys
inert_why.ps-custom-not-colour: custom particle data is a colour only in mode 2
inert_why.material-vector: the material's shader declares this property as a vector, not a colour
inert_why.material-stale: the material's shader does not declare this property (left from an earlier shader)
inert_why.material-unused-prop: the property is declared for compatibility and the shader never reads it (URP's _Color)
inert_why.camera-no-clear: a camera's background colour is drawn only when it clears to a solid colour
inert_why.fog-off: the fog colour is drawn only with fog on (no runtime code turns it on)
inert_why.ambient-mode: the scene's ambient mode does not read this ambient colour (or adds black)
inert_why.subtractive-off: the subtractive shadow colour is read only by Mixed lights in Subtractive mode (no scene has one)
inert_why.gi-output: an output of the GI bake that Unity serializes, read by nothing
inert_why.post-inactive: a volume component that is not active, or a parameter whose override is off
inert_why.post-identity: a post-processing parameter at its identity (white tint or filter, zero intensity, grey toning)
inert_why.shader-default: a shader default every material saves over; no code or asset builds a material from the shader
inert_why.debug: logs, gizmos, debug draws, editor-only and development-build-only code and diagnostic overlays (CLAUDE.md excludes them from player-facing rules)
inert_why.code-inert: a C# colour literal that never reaches a pixel (a serialized default every instance overrides, an alpha-0 sentinel, a value overwritten before it draws): colour_trace_review.json says which and why
inert_why.code-fallback: a C# colour literal shown only when a reference is unwired, which no shipped scene leaves unwired: colour_trace_review.json says which and why
inert_why.stale-field: a serialized key the component's class no longer declares (nor names in FormerlySerializedAs): Unity never reads it
inert_why.field-reviewed: a serialized colour field that never reaches a pixel or is shown only when a reference is unwired: colour_trace_review.json says which and why
inert_why.shader-node-dead: a ShaderGraph colour node with no edge path to a Block node or a sub-graph's output: never drawn
inert_why.shader-not-drawn: shader code no reachable material, asset or Shader.Find uses (directly or as a sub-graph or include): compiled at most, never drawn
inert_why.unreachable: an asset no player build can load: no enabled scene, Resources folder, project setting or Addressables group reaches it through any chain of references (colour_trace.py reachable)
inert_why.script-missing: a component whose script is not in the repository (deleted): it never runs
inert_why.tmp-feature-off: a TextMesh Pro material colour whose feature is off (no GLOW_ON, UNDERLAY_ON or BEVEL_ON keyword, outline width 0)
